text: Claude is the product of Anthropic PBC, a company structured as a public benefit corporation. Court filings in the Google antitrust case, reviewed by the New York Times, show Alphabet (Google) owned about 14% of Anthropic as of March 2025 (capped at 15%, with no voting rights, board seats, or board-observer rights). The same reporting notes Amazon invested $4 billion in 2023 and a further $4 billion in 2024, but does not disclose a resulting ownership percentage for Amazon, and does not address Anthropic's state of incorporation or any state ownership.

source.name: The New York Times - 'Inside Google's Investment in Anthropic'
source.quote: Google owns 14 percent of Anthropic, according to legal filings that the A.I. start-up submitted as part of a Google antitrust case.
